notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/sryu1__jsbgym --backend fake (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null and no hardware run was made. The fake backend is the package's own pure-Python kinematic stand-in, not JSBSim: the gate does not install gymnasium, jsbsim, numpy or matplotlib, package code never imports or installs the clone, and the fake was never compared with a JSBSim run. The sim backend (gymnasium.make of the registered NoFG environment) was not run. The fidelity contract is F0 for the deployed stand-in; its gaps state the missing aerodynamics, the placeholder reward, the lack of wall-clock pacing, rendering and snapshot/restore, and the fixed HeadingControlTask start state. The action space (three control-surface commands in -1..1) and the 11-value observation shape come from the upstream environment. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only selects the seed of the next reset, so it makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for inputs the bridge derives (reset seed, seed seed, ticks and the dimensionless action.values). No catalogue requests: only cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used. No site-limits.example.json: the device is simulated R0 and the only bounds are the environment's action space and the bridge's tick bound. gate.digest is the digest line the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
